    Module lines from thin modules #

    Let g 0, …, g n be points of a piece joined by arrows only between consecutive points, and Y a module over the piece algebra, one-dimensional at the g i and zero elsewhere, on which each arrow g i — g (i + 1) acts. Then composites along the sequence act injectively on the spaces of Y (actInj_of_path), paths of the cover through the points have nonzero value (nz_line'; this is nz_line without asking the piece to be a forest), and the points with the representation of Y form a module line (mline_of_seq).

    ActInj k Y (g m) (g b)

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.pointBrickAt_critical_line {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (hS : Cover.Convex ↑S) (hne : S.Nonempty) (hacycCov : CoverAcyclic x₀) (hint : ∀ (a b : Cover x₀), (interval a b).Finite) (hlsc : CoverLocalSC x₀) (hrep : ¬PieceRepFin k S) (hmin : ∀ (C' : Finset (Cover x₀)), Cover.Convex ↑C' → C'.card < S.card → PieceRepFin k C') :
    ∃ (T' : Set (pieceQuiver S).V) (x : (pieceQuiver S).V) (Vr : Rep k (pieceQuiver S)), PointBrickAt x Vr ∧ x ∈ T' ∧ (∀ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V), Nontrivial ↑(Vr.obj i) → i ∈ T') ∧ (T'.ncard ≤ 29 ∨ ∃ (L : MLine x₀ S k), T'.ncard ≤ L.n + 3)

    A critical piece carries point–brick data on a set T' of points, and if T' has at least 30 points, a module line with |T'| - 3 arrows.
